# 7-Day Tokyo Family Trip Plan

A balanced family itinerary for **2 adults + 2 kids** from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-16** with a focus on **culture, food, and one theme-park day**. Costs below are estimated in **USD** and designed to stay within your **$4,500 budget excluding international flights**.

# Day-by-Day Tokyo Itinerary

## Day 1: Arrival + Easy Asakusa Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, rest, and pick up a transit card if needed.
- **Afternoon:** Light neighborhood stroll around your hotel area; keep this day low-effort after travel.
- **Dinner:** Asakusa area dinner with tempura, ramen, or family-friendly set meals.
- **Transit:** Use **Airport Limousine Bus** or **Keisei Skyliner/JR** depending on arrival airport; then taxis or subway for the final leg.
- **Estimated daily cost:** **$220–$320** total.

## Day 2: Asakusa, Skytree, and Sumida River
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Senso-ji Temple, Nakamise shopping street, and nearby snack stops.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/16/20181123_Sens%C5%8D-ji-1.jpg Alt=Morning:** Senso-ji Temple, Nakamise shopping street, and nearby snack stops, Tokyo, Japan
- **Afternoon:** Tokyo Skytree for city views and lunch at Solamachi.
- **Dinner:** Family dinner in Asakusa or Oshiage; try curry rice or izakaya-style non-alcoholic family sets.
- **Transit:** Subway is easiest; Asakusa, Oshiage, and Skytree are well connected.
- **Estimated daily cost:** **$260–$380** total.

## Day 3: Ueno Park, Museums, and Ameyoko
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Morning:** Ueno Park and one museum choice, such as the Tokyo National Museum or National Museum of Nature and Science.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/31/2014_02_08_ueno.jpg Alt=Morning:** Ueno Park and one museum choice, such as the Tokyo National Museum or National Museum of Nature and Science, Tokyo, Japan
- **Afternoon:** Ameyoko market area for casual shopping and street-food snacks.
- **Dinner:** Ueno or Akihabara area dinner; good for noodles, tonkatsu, or conveyor-belt sushi.
- **Transit:** JR Yamanote Line and local walking; this is one of the easiest low-stress days.
- **Estimated daily cost:** **$180–$300** total.

## Day 4: Theme-Park Day at Tokyo Disney Resort
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/ticket-perforated.svg
- **Morning:** Head early to **Tokyo Disneyland** or **Tokyo DisneySea**.
- **Afternoon:** Stay in the park, use mobile ordering where available, and plan breaks for the kids.
- **Dinner:** Eat inside the resort or nearby at Ikspiari if you want more variety.
- **Transit:** JR Keiyo Line to Maihama, then resort monorail or walk.
- **Estimated daily cost:** **$420–$620** total, depending on ticket prices, meals, and souvenirs.

## Day 5: Harajuku, Meiji Jingu, and Shibuya
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Morning:** Meiji Jingu shrine and Yoyogi Park for a calm cultural start.
Media: Alt=Morning:** Meiji Jingu shrine and Yoyogi Park for a calm cultural start, Tokyo, Japan
- **Afternoon:** Harajuku browsing, then Shibuya Crossing, Shibuya Sky, or a family-friendly shopping break.
- **Dinner:** Shibuya dinner with sushi, udon, or a casual burger/tonkatsu place for the kids.
- **Transit:** JR Yamanote Line and short walks; taxis can help if the kids get tired.
- **Estimated daily cost:** **$240–$380** total.

## Day 6: Odaiba Waterfront + TeamLab-style Indoor Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Odaiba waterfront walk, DiverCity, or Miraikan depending on interest.
- **Afternoon:** Indoor art or science attraction, then shopping and arcade time.
- **Dinner:** Odaiba or nearby Toyosu area seafood, casual Japanese set meals, or mall dining.
- **Transit:** Yurikamome Line is fun for kids and gives great bay views.
- **Estimated daily cost:** **$220–$360** total.

## Day 7: Tsukiji, Ginza, and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Morning:** Tsukiji Outer Market for breakfast and snack tasting.
- **Afternoon:** Ginza stroll, souvenir shopping, or a relaxed café break before departure.
- **Dinner:** If flying out later, choose a simple airport or station meal; if not, enjoy a final Tokyo dinner in Ginza.
- **Transit:** Subway or taxi depending on luggage and departure timing.
- **Estimated daily cost:** **$180–$320** total.

# Budget Plan and Transit Guide

| Day | Main Focus | Transit Style | Estimated Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Arrival + Asakusa | Airport transfer + subway/taxi | $220–$320 |
| Day 2 | Culture + skyline | Subway + walking | $260–$380 |
| Day 3 | Museums + market | JR line + walking | $180–$300 |
| Day 4 | Theme park | JR + resort monorail | $420–$620 |
| Day 5 | Harajuku + Shibuya | JR line + short taxi rides | $240–$380 |
| Day 6 | Odaiba + indoor attractions | Yurikamome + subway | $220–$360 |
| Day 7 | Tsukiji + Ginza | Subway + taxi if needed | $180–$320 |

- **Estimated trip total:** **$1,720–$2,680** for the core daily plan.
- That leaves a comfortable buffer for:
  - a nicer hotel,
  - extra meals/snacks,
  - souvenirs,
  - taxis on tired days,
  - or upgraded theme-park spending.

## Transit Suggestions That Work Well for Families
- Buy **IC cards** for everyone for easy subway and convenience-store use.
- Stay near a major line such as **JR Yamanote**, **Tokyo Metro Ginza Line**, or **Asakusa Line**.
- Use **taxis strategically** for late evenings, rainy days, or when kids are tired.
- Keep one “slow morning” and one “easy dinner” built into the week to avoid overload.

# Rainy-Day Backup Activities

## Backup 1: Tokyo National Museum or Miraikan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Best for a full indoor day with culture or science.
- Good fit for both ages, especially if you want a calm pace.
- Easy to combine with lunch nearby and short transit rides.

## Backup 2: teamLab Planets or Similar Immersive Indoor Art
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Great “wow” factor for kids and adults.
- Fully indoor and visually engaging.
- Works well on a rainy afternoon if you want something memorable.

## Backup 3: Sunshine City, Tokyo Solamachi, or Large Mall + Aquarium/Play Zone
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Best for flexible weather-proof planning.
- Combines shopping, food, play areas, and easy rest breaks.
- Ideal if you need a low-stress substitute for a walking-heavy day.
